items.t: Fair Isaac (FICO) Names Julie May President Of B2B Scores
items.sum: Fair Isaac (NYSE:FICO) expanded its Preferred Program to additional major mortgage credit resellers, including Factual Data. Factual Data is expected to begin offering FICO Preferred Program score bundles to mortgage lenders from January 2027. items.t: Factual Data Adds the FICO® Preferred Program to Its Mortgage Credit Platform
items.sum: BOZEMAN, Mont., November 25, 2026--Factual Data will offer the FICO® Preferred Program to its mortgage lender clients beginning January 1, 2027.
